members.name: class
members.description: Custom CSS classes added to the table root container.

members.name: data
members.description: The rows to display. Generic type T is carried through column definitions, row events, and the programmatic API.

members.name: columns

references.name: DataTableColumn

members.description: The column definitions that control headers, value access, sorting, filtering, rendering, and column layout.

members.name: sortable
members.description: Enables sortable-column header interaction and sorted data; an individual column can opt out with sortable: false.

members.name: filterable
members.description: Shows the global search input and column filters for columns that declare filterType.

members.name: filterPlaceholder
members.description: The global search input placeholder and accessible name; when omitted, the localized dataTable.filterPlaceholder message is used.

members.name: selectable
members.description: Shows row checkboxes and a select-all checkbox, and enables reading and exporting selected rows.

members.name: paginated
members.description: Enables page slicing and the pagination controls.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: The number of rows per page when pagination is enabled; data is not sliced into pages when pagination is disabled.

members.name: pageSizeOptions
members.description: The page sizes offered by the pagination control.

members.name: loading
members.description: Displays the loading overlay and the loading slot content.

members.name: emptyMessage
members.description: The empty-state message; when omitted or empty, the localized dataTable.noData message is used.

members.name: rowKey
members.description: Provides a unique row-key field or accessor; row selection and expansion rely on the resolved string or number key.

members.name: rowClickable
members.description: Makes a row activate the row-click event through pointer click or the Enter key.

members.name: title
members.description: The heading shown above the table when the header slot is not supplied.

members.name: description
members.description: The supporting text shown below the heading when the header slot is not supplied.

members.name: section
members.description: Applies a constrained width and centered layout to the table root container.

members.name: framed
members.description: Controls the root border, shadow, and rounded corners; false removes those frame styles.

members.name: virtualScroll

references.name: DataTableVirtualScroll

members.description: Configures row virtualization. It is enabled when enabled is true; rowHeight can be fixed or measured dynamically with auto.

members.name: size
members.description: Sets the table size variant.

members.name: dense
members.description: Uses more compact row and cell spacing.

members.name: striped
members.description: Controls alternating background stripes on data rows.

members.name: stickyHeader
members.description: Makes the header sticky at the top of its scrolling container.

members.name: expandable
members.description: Shows row expansion controls and allows the expanded-row slot to render.

members.name: expandRowKeys
members.description: The controlled set of expanded row keys. Keys must match rowKey resolution, and changes synchronize the internal expansion state.

members.name: spanMethod
members.description: Calculates a merge span for each displayed row and visible column. Return rowspan and colspan, or nothing to use the default span.

members.name: sort
members.description: Emits the column ID and direction after the user interacts with a sortable header; direction is asc, desc, or null.

members.name: filter

references.name: DataTableFilterState

members.description: Emits the current global and column filter state when filtering changes.

members.name: select
members.description: Emits the selected row data array after the user toggles a row or the current-page select-all control.

members.name: page-change
members.description: Emits the page number after user navigation changes the current page; no event is emitted when the page stays the same.

members.name: page-size-change
members.description: Emits the new page size after the user selects it in the pagination control.

members.name: expand-change
members.description: Emits the row data and its new expanded boolean when the row expansion state toggles.

members.name: row-click
members.description: When rowClickable is enabled, emits row data after a pointer click or Enter activation; events originating inside buttons, inputs, links, or other interactive elements are ignored.

members.name: export
members.description: Emits the selected format and current selected-row array when a table export control is activated.

members.name: header
members.description: Replaces the default table header; when omitted, the heading area is rendered from title and description.

members.name: toolbar
members.description: Additional content for the global filtering toolbar; when filterable is enabled, it appears beside the search input.

members.name: expanded-row
members.description: Additional expanded-row content with row and its index in the displayed list; rendered only for an expanded row when expandable is enabled.

members.name: empty
members.description: Replaces the empty-state content; rendered only when there is no display data and loading is false.

members.name: loading
members.description: Replaces the loading overlay content; rendered only when loading is true.

members.name: footer
members.description: Additional footer content rendered after the table and loading area.

members.name: sort

type.text: { toggleSort: (columnId: string) => void; sortState: Readonly<Ref<{ readonly column: string; readonly direction: "asc" | "desc" | null; }, { readonly column: string; readonly direction: "asc" | "desc" | null; }>>; }

members.description: The table sorting namespace, containing toggleSort and the read-only sortState.

members.name: sort.toggleSort
members.description: Toggles sorting for a column ID. Sorting must be enabled and the column must not opt out; the cycle is ascending, descending, then cleared.

members.name: sort.sortState

type.text: Readonly<Ref<{ readonly column: string; readonly direction: "asc" | "desc" | null; }, { readonly column: string; readonly direction: "asc" | "desc" | null; }>>

members.description: The read-only reactive sort state containing the current column ID and asc, desc, or null direction.

members.name: filter

type.text: { filterState: Readonly<Ref<{ readonly global?: string | undefined; readonly columns: { readonly [x: string]: string | number | readonly (string | number)[] | { readonly start: string | null; readonly end: string | null; } | null | undefined; }; }, { readonly global?: string | undefined; readonly columns: { readonly [x: string]: string | number | readonly (string | number)[] | { readonly start: string | null; readonly end: string | null; } | null | undefined; }; }>>; setGlobalFilter: (value: string) => void; setFilterState: (state: DataTableFilterState) => void; }

references.name: DataTableFilterState

members.description: The table filtering namespace, providing state access and methods to set global or complete filter criteria.

members.name: filter.filterState

type.text: Readonly<Ref<{ readonly global?: string | undefined; readonly columns: { readonly [x: string]: string | number | readonly (string | number)[] | { readonly start: string | null; readonly end: string | null; } | null | undefined; }; }, { readonly global?: string | undefined; readonly columns: { readonly [x: string]: string | number | readonly (string | number)[] | { readonly start: string | null; readonly end: string | null; } | null | undefined; }; }>>

members.description: The read-only reactive filter state, with an optional global value and columns indexed by column ID.

members.name: filter.setGlobalFilter
members.description: Sets the global search keyword.

members.name: filter.setFilterState

references.name: DataTableFilterState

members.description: Replaces the complete filtering state with the supplied DataTableFilterState.

members.name: selection

type.text: { toggleRow: (row: T) => void; toggleAllRows: () => void; clearSelection: () => void; getSelectedRows: () => T[]; selectedRows: Readonly<ShallowRef<ReadonlySet<string | number>>>; isAllSelected: ComputedRef<boolean>; }

members.description: The table selection namespace, providing row-selection actions, selected-key state, and a method to read selected row data.

members.name: selection.toggleRow
members.description: Toggles selection for the specified row; selectable must be enabled.

members.name: selection.toggleAllRows
members.description: Toggles selection for all rows on the current display page; clearing preserves selections from other pages or filtered-out rows.

members.name: selection.clearSelection
members.description: Clears all selected row keys.

members.name: selection.getSelectedRows
members.description: Returns the full row data array for the current selection.

members.name: selection.selectedRows
members.description: The read-only shallow-reactive set of selected row keys.

members.name: selection.isAllSelected
members.description: A read-only computed state indicating whether all rows on the current display page are selected.

members.name: pagination

type.text: { goToPage: (page: number) => boolean; nextPage: () => boolean; previousPage: () => boolean; setPageSize: (size: number) => void; pageIndex: Readonly<Ref<number, number>>; pageCount: ComputedRef<number>; }

members.description: The table pagination namespace, containing page state and pagination control methods.

members.name: pagination.goToPage
members.description: Navigates to the requested page, clamps it to the valid range, and returns whether the page changed.

members.name: pagination.nextPage
members.description: Attempts to move to the next page and returns whether the page changed.

members.name: pagination.previousPage
members.description: Attempts to move to the previous page and returns whether the page changed.

members.name: pagination.setPageSize
members.description: Sets the page size and resets the current page to the first page; invalid sizes are ignored.

members.name: pagination.pageIndex
members.description: The read-only reactive current page number, starting at 1.

members.name: pagination.pageCount
members.description: The read-only computed page count; it is at least 1 when there are no rows.

members.name: expand

type.text: { toggleRow: (row: T) => void; isRowExpanded: (row: T) => boolean; expandedRowKeys: ShallowRef<Set<string | number>, Set<string | number>>; }

members.description: The table row-expansion namespace, providing toggle and query methods plus the expanded-key state.

members.name: expand.toggleRow
members.description: Toggles expansion for the specified row and emits expand-change.

members.name: expand.isRowExpanded
members.description: Checks whether the specified row is currently expanded.

members.name: expand.expandedRowKeys
members.description: The shallow-reactive set containing the currently expanded row keys.

members.name: cell-{columnId}
members.description: Provides custom content for a column cell. Use the cell-{columnId} slot name; its scope exposes the current row and cell value.
notes: Used only for regular data columns. If absent, the table falls back to the column cell renderer or the default cell value.

members.name: column

references.name: DataTableColumn

members.description: The column definition for this filter control; its filterType and filterOptions determine the filter UI.

members.name: filterState

type.text: { readonly global?: string | undefined; readonly columns: { readonly [x: string]: string | number | readonly (string | number)[] | { readonly start: string | null; readonly end: string | null; } | null | undefined; }; }

members.description: The current read-only filter state, used to display this column’s text, option, or date-range value.

members.name: headerLabel
members.description: The displayed column-header text used to label the filter control.

members.name: update:filterState

references.name: DataTableFilterState

members.description: Emits a state object containing only the current column change when its filter value changes; a null column value clears that column filter.
